value.summary: Abstract Apoptosis, or programmed cell death, has long been appreciated to play a central physiological role in embryogenesis, synaptogenesis, immune response, and normal tissue and organ involution. With the recognition that an aberration of apoptosis can contribute to the pathogenesis of a variety of disease states, including parenchymal death associated with microcirculatory disorders, the subject of apoptosis has emerged as one of the hottest field of study in recent years. Apoptosis is a highly organized and orchestrated form of cellular suicide.
